messages:
Elaine (eng-platform): quick sync — need alignment on request-id header name and trace sampling for the console dashboards. proposal: use `X-RD-REQUEST-ID` and only attach `trace_id` + `span_id` to logs when the request is sampled. thoughts?

Sam (eng-runtime): prefer `X-RW-REQ-ID` since we already use rw prefix elsewhere, shorter. runtime already emits W3C `traceparent`. are we introducing a second id to solve dashboard joins or to let customers pin id?

Elaine (eng-platform): main goal is cross-layer dashboard correlation without ingesting full traces for every request. we need: 1) a stable request id that survives ingress->runtime->backend, 2) a boolean/flag to indicate whether a full trace exists so console can surface links.

Nicole (eng-infra): infra note: nginx/edge will drop unknown headers unless configured. we can preserve either header but will need an ingress config change and tests. also we should avoid adding high-cardinality labels directly to metrics pipelines.

Mike (eng-console): console needs a consistent field to show "trace available" and a URL template to link into trace UI. UX: show 'Trace available' badge and a link when present; show a log search link otherwise. partial traces are ok.

Carlos (product): I'd rather we pick `X-RD-REQUEST-ID` to avoid overlapping with client headers. product wants to aggregate latency/error by route/model and allow drilldown when a trace exists.

Anya (oncall): oncall needs continuity. we currently rely on `req-id`. renaming will be a pain unless we accept both during rollout. can runtime honor incoming header or generate if absent?

Sam (eng-runtime): yes runtime will honor incoming `X-RD-REQUEST-ID` or `X-RW-REQ-ID` and generate if missing. we will keep emitting W3C `traceparent` and only include `trace_id` + `span_id` in structured logs when sampling_decision == 1.

Nicole (eng-infra): proposed sampling policy: hosted default 0.1% uniform, dedicated default 1% (configurable per-customer), always sample error traces and any request that hits anomaly detectors. We should expose `trace_available` boolean as a metric label.

Elaine (eng-platform): agreed. also we should add a telemetry metric `request.trace_link` (true/false) and a lightweight `request.req_id` only in debug/log tables, not as a primary metric label to avoid cardinality blowup. dashboards should use `trace_link` for counts and only join to logs/traces when drilling down.

Mike (eng-console): console will add a 'Requests with traces' panel and a drilldown that opens `/traces/{trace_id}`. we need the exact trace url template. runtime: will you normalize the trace_id format?

Sam (eng-runtime): trace ids follow the W3C hex format; we'll pass them through as-is. structured logs fields we plan to emit when sampled: `req_id`, `trace_id`, `span_id`. metric labels: `route`, `model`, `trace_available:true|false`.

Elaine (eng-platform): Implementation checklist for owners:
- runtime: accept either header, generate if missing, add structured log fields when sampled
- infra: preserve header at ingress and add tests
- console: add trace_available panel and drilldown link
- product: confirm aggregation requirements
- oncall: update runbooks

Sam (eng-runtime): quick snippet for runtime config we plan to land:
```
# runtime request handling
req_id = request.header.get('X-RD-REQUEST-ID') or request.header.get('X-RW-REQ-ID') or generate_uuid()
if sampling_decision == 1:
  log.bind(req_id=req_id, trace_id=trace_id, span_id=span_id)
else:
  log.bind(req_id=req_id)
metrics.increment('request.count', labels={"route": route, "model": model, "trace_available": sampling_decision == 1})
```

Nicole (eng-infra): rollout idea: accept both headers for 4 weeks, add ingress tests, then flip recommendation in docs. I'll prepare the nginx snippet and a change request for LB configs.

Anya (oncall): ack. I'll add a step to the incident runbook to look for trace links and fallback to log search when `trace_available=false`.

Mike (eng-console): ack. I'll open a console ticket for the panel and the trace link UX. will also add a small message when link isn't available.

Carlos (product): ack. please include example dashboard queries in the PR description.

Sam (eng-runtime): will post RFC draft here: https://go/internal/rfcs/reqid-trace-sampling (will follow up with PRs).

deploy-bot: PR merged to staging: pr/4723 — runtime: accept rd/rw req-id headers and emit req_id in logs

Elaine (eng-platform): timeline: runtime + ingress PRs by EOD Friday, console schema changes next week, 2-week gradual rollout. owners, please ack if that timeline works.

Anya (oncall): ack for oncall.

Nicole (eng-infra): ack, will start ingress work tomorrow.

Mike (eng-console): ack.

Elaine (eng-platform): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
